name: Typing Viper
source:
Under pressure to improve your typing skills in real life, you find yourself dreaming every night about scenarios from various VIPER games in which proficient typing would be used to solve a particular problem. As your skills improve, the stages get progressively harder.

[From [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/series/typing.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
translation:
现实中提高打字速度的压力，让你每晚都会梦见《VIPER》系列中的不同场景，并靠熟练输入文字解决某个难题。随着打字能力提升，关卡也会越来越难。

[译自 [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/series/typing.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
